_comment: Prose golden set. Every check is a RULE VIOLATION check, deliberately: the meal-plan suite's lesson was that a non-deterministic scorer inside a deterministic suite buys a gradient nobody can trust. What this measures is whether a model can produce SHIPPABLE prose under the node's constraints - placeholders only, no money, correct attribution - not whether the sentence is pleasant. The prose node degrades on every failure, so a model that cannot follow the rules delivers nothing and the shopper gets a bare table.

cases.note: The simplest possible case. If this degrades, the model cannot use the placeholder protocol at all.

cases.message: price of butter and milk and bread
cases.note: Multi-item. More citations means more placeholders to choose between, and more ways to attribute the cheapest one wrongly.
Plan prose uses the figure placeholders ([[total]], [[budget]]) rather than citations, which resolve to fixed words and never to a number.

cases.message: dinner for 4 for a week on $120, vegetarian
meals for 1 person for 5 days, budget $40

cases.note: Nothing retrieved, so the graph terminates at emit_no_data and prose never runs. Prose here would be a sentence about a price we do not have.
Out of scope terminates before retrieval. Included so the suite fails if prose starts appearing on turns that have no citations behind it.
